_about: ACME-LOAN: one non-fungible token per loan (program `loan-nft-program`, standard UNITS-Loan). Created with /v1/token/mint (mint == loan_originated, needs the full LoanOriginatedPayload in `data`), then the 21 further domain operations via /v1/token/transact. Not transferable (federation transfer rejects UNITS-Loan). Loan JSON keys are camelCase; u128 fields are integer strings, u32 fields are JSON numbers.

register.name: ACME Loan Note
register.description: One token per loan account; carries the loan lifecycle from origination to closure.

schema.description: Documentation only (not enforced). The loan-nft-program validates LoanOriginatedPayload.
